Container.Name: swarmtenderr
Container.Overview: Understand and control your qBittorrent queue. Live statistics, explainable ranking, bounded discovery trials, audited manual actions, local accounts and Authentik-compatible OIDC. SQLite is included; PostgreSQL is optional. One installation manages one qBittorrent 5 client. Prepare the private bootstrap-password file and enter your exact browser-facing Public URL before starting. Start in Observe mode. This template is awaiting native Unraid acceptance; see the installation guide.
Container.Requires: qBittorrent 5; writable appdata owned by UID/GID 10001; private admin-password file. See ReadMe before installation.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: qbittorrent arr queue optimizer torrents authentik sqlite postgres

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the dashboard. Keep Public URL in sync if this changes.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and runtime encryption key. Owner must be UID/GID 10001. Back up this directory.

Config.Name: Private secret directory
Config.Description: Read-only directory containing admin-password and any optional PostgreSQL connection file. Follow the private-file preparation in ReadMe.

Config.Name: Public URL (required)
Config.Description: Exact origin used in your browser, for example http://192.0.2.10:8788 or your HTTPS reverse-proxy origin. Enter your real server address; no trailing path.

Config.Name: Bootstrap password file
Config.Description: Private initial administrator password file, at least 12 characters. Its contents never belong in this form or template.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL connection file (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty for SQLite. To use your PostgreSQL database, place postgres-url in the private secret directory and set this to /run/secrets/swarmtenderr/postgres-url. See the PostgreSQL instructions in ReadMe.
